items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Dan Moody. Dan Moody, I played with him.

ctx.x: Is he dead? Oh, he's dead. That's why I was thinking a couple weeks ago, all the people I knew, they were dead. When I was sick in 43, fellas come on Fusher Street, come and buy my home. I told my wife, I said, don't sell the home, I might play the game. So she didn't sell the home. In 1944, I played over in Coverture, this big fellow that he died last year. He's a bass player in the Tramont Club too. Dan Moody. Dan Moody, I played with him. So the sick is going to die.
No. You don't know though. You can't tell. You never can tell. Yeah, sure was quick, you know, the way he came for red clock.
